method: Apple SHARP, independently predicted from one image per case; SPZ quantization + Spark browser rendering
evaluation: Input image resized with Lanczos to browser render resolution; RGB PSNR/SSIM without image alignment or exposure correction. Not independent novel-view or geometry accuracy. Different resolutions and inputs from the mesh benchmark prevent a matched-budget method comparison.
limitations: Cup segmentation exposes missing background and residual boundary splats when moved.
Appearance preview has no collision simulation.
No multi-view Gaussian training or online updating was performed.
